title: Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter Saturn Ryu first pass
purpose: Official-port research lane augmenting the AvP Saturn conversion

source.route: Two-player Ryu/Ken vs Spider-Man/Captain America; P2 remains neutral after setup

included: cold boot and deterministic menu route
deferred: Hadouken command acceptance and projectile lifecycle
Saturn RAM, VDP, SCSP, CD, and DMA traces

claims.claim: The official Saturn port reaches a controllable Ryu/Ken versus Spider-Man/Captain America match with P2 neutral after setup.
evidence: two cold replays with 25 identical screenshot hashes
claims.test: Cold boot with the same disc, cartridge, backup state, and replay record.
claims.falsification: A replay reaches different teams, accepts a P2 gameplay input, or changes any screenshot hash.

claims.claim: The deterministic first pass contains idle, forward walk, jump, standing normal, collision, a visible HUD health response, Spider-Man hit reaction, and recovery in that order.
evidence: FIRST ATTACK and Spider-Man reaction visible at frame 3840
claims.test: Replay the controller record and require the same event order and anchor hashes.
claims.falsification: The normal whiffs, P2 moves before impact, the HUD does not respond, or an anchor hash changes.

remaining_uncertainty: The exact Saturn health value, damage amount, collision boxes, hitstop, and actor structures are not mapped.
The first pass deliberately defers Hadouken command acceptance and projectile spawn, travel, ownership, collision, and recovery.
Saturn audio-event routing is not captured.
Visual equivalence does not establish identical CPS-2 and Saturn mechanics or timing.
rights_boundary: Replay records, raw screenshots, backup data, and disc media remain ignored private inputs; this tracked report contains hashes and derived observations only.
